title: Grant va motivatsion xat
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz grant yoki stipendiya uchun besh qismli motivatsion xat tuzasiz: kirishni maqsad va aniq voqea bilan boshlaysiz, yutuqlaringizni kuchli fe’l va raqamlar bilan isbotlaysiz, o‘tmish, hozir va kelajakni to‘g‘ri zamonlar bilan bog‘laysiz hamda ishonchli, lekin kamtar ohangda yozasiz.

vocab.uz: motivatsion xat (statement of purpose ham deyiladi)
stipendiya, grant — o‘qish xarajatini qoplaydigan mablag‘

scenes.title: Pulni hal qiladigan xat
board: Motivation Letters for Grants
(Grant va stipendiya uchun motivatsion xat)
structure · achievements · past → future · tone
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda xorijiy universitetga hujjat topshirishni o‘rgandik. Bugun arizadagi eng muhim hujjatga o‘tamiz: grant yoki stipendiya uchun motivatsion xat. Ko‘pincha komissiya sizni faqat shu xat orqali taniydi. Dars oxirida siz aniq tuzilishli, yutuqlari dalillangan, ohangi to‘g‘ri xat yoza olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Today we write the document that often decides who gets the money: the motivation letter.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz! Bugun ko‘pincha pulni kim olishini hal qiladigan hujjatni yozamiz: motivatsion xat.

scenes.title: Komissiya to‘rtta savolga javob izlaydi
board: motivation letter ≈ statement of purpose
Why you? → evidence · Why this programme? → fit
Why now? → timing · What next? → impact
Chevening · DAAD · Erasmus Mundus · El-Yurt Umidi
scenes.say_native: Bu hujjat motivation letter yoki statement of purpose deb ataladi. Chevening, DAAD yoki El-Yurt Umidi bo‘ladimi, komissiya to‘rtta savolga javob izlaydi: nega aynan siz, nega shu dastur, nega hozir va keyin nima qilasiz. Grant beruvchi investor kabi o‘ylaydi: u sizning kelajakdagi ta’siringizni ko‘rmoqchi.
scenes.say: Every committee looks for four answers. Why you? Why this programme? Why now? And what will you do next?
scenes.say_uz: Har bir komissiya to‘rtta javob izlaydi. Nega siz? Nega bu dastur? Nega hozir? Va keyin nima qilasiz?

scenes.title: Besh qismli tuzilish
board: 1 Opening: purpose + hook
2 Background · 3 Achievements (evidence)
4 Why this programme → future goals
5 Closing: thanks
scenes.say_native: Birinchi mavzu: tuzilish. Klassik xat besh qismdan iborat: maqsad va qiziqtiruvchi detalli kirish, ta’lim va tajriba, dalilli yutuqlar, nega aynan shu dastur va keyingi maqsadlar, qisqa minnatdorchilik. Maktab inshosidagi uzun muqaddima kerak emas: asosiy fikr birinchi xatboshida bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: A classic letter has five parts: an opening with a hook, your background, your achievements, why this programme and what comes next, and a short closing.
scenes.say_uz: Klassik xat besh qismdan iborat: ilgakli kirish, ta’lim va tajriba, yutuqlar, nega bu dastur va keyin nima, hamda qisqa yakun.

scenes.title: Namuna: kuchli kirish
board: Purpose: I am applying for…
Hook: a specific moment
Main idea: That day I realised that…
scenes.say_native: Bu kirishni diqqat bilan tinglang. Birinchi gap maqsadni darhol aytadi: qaysi grant va qaysi dastur. Ikkinchi gap ilgak, ya’ni hook: aniq joy, aniq vaqt va aniq muammo. Uchinchi gap shu voqeadan chiqqan xulosa, u butun xatning asosiy g‘oyasiga aylanadi. Komissiya a’zosi birinchi o‘n soniyada kimligingizni biladi.
scenes.say: Dear Selection Committee, I am applying for the Chevening Scholarship to study for an MSc in Public Health. Three years ago, during a vaccination campaign in rural Fergana, I watched a whole village refuse a free vaccine because of one rumour on social media. That day I realised that health systems fail not only for lack of medicine, but for lack of trust.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli tanlov komissiyasi, men jamoat salomatligi magistraturasida o‘qish uchun Chevening stipendiyasiga ariza topshiryapman. Uch yil oldin Farg‘ona qishloqlaridagi emlash kampaniyasida butun bir qishloq ijtimoiy tarmoqdagi bitta mish-mish sababli bepul emlashdan bosh tortganini ko‘rdim. O‘sha kuni sog‘liqni saqlash tizimlari nafaqat dori, balki ishonch yetishmasligidan ham yiqilishini angladim.

scenes.title: Zaif kirishlar
board: ✗ My name is Aziz. I was born in 2001 in Namangan.
✗ Since my childhood I have dreamed of studying abroad.
✗ It is a great honour for me to write this letter.
✓ I am applying for… + a specific moment
scenes.say_native: Uchta klassik zaif kirish. Birinchisi tarjimai hol: ismingiz va tug‘ilgan yilingiz anketada allaqachon bor. Ikkinchisi “since my childhood I have dreamed”: bu ibora juda ko‘p xatda uchraydi va hech narsani isbotlamaydi. Uchinchisi “it is a great honour for me” kabi bo‘sh rasmiyatchilik. O‘rniga maqsad va aniq voqea bilan boshlang.
scenes.say: Your date of birth is already on the form. And hundreds of applicants say they have dreamed of this since childhood. Start with your purpose and a real moment.
scenes.say_uz: Tug‘ilgan sanangiz anketada allaqachon bor. Yuzlab arizachilar bolalikdan orzu qilganini yozadi. Maqsadingiz va real voqea bilan boshlang.

scenes.title: Xatboshilarni tartiblang
board: A Upon completion, I intend to return to the ministry…
B I am applying for the DAAD scholarship to study…
C Thank you for considering my application.
D In 2024, I led a team of six engineers that…
scenes.say_native: Doskada to‘rtta xatboshining birinchi gapi bor, lekin ular aralashib ketgan. To‘g‘ri tartibni toping: qaysi biri kirish, qaysi biri yutuq, qaysi biri kelajak rejasi va qaysi biri yakun. Har bir gapdagi kalit so‘zlarga va fe’l zamoniga e’tibor bering, ular yo‘l ko‘rsatadi. Harflarni ketma-ket ayting.
scenes.say: Put these four paragraph openings in the right order.
scenes.say_uz: Bu to‘rtta xatboshi boshlanishini to‘g‘ri tartibga qo‘ying.

scenes.title: Javoblar: B, D, A, C
board: B → D → A → C
B = purpose · D = evidence (past)
A = future · C = closing
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri tartib: B, D, A, C. B “I am applying for” bilan boshlanadi, demak bu kirish. D o‘tgan zamon va aniq yil bilan keladi, bu yutuq. A “upon completion” iborasi bilan kelajakka qaraydi. C xatni yopadi. Zamonlar ham tuzilishni ko‘rsatib turibdi: hozirgi, o‘tgan, kelasi. Bu haqda uchinchi qismda batafsil gaplashamiz.
scenes.say: The order is B, D, A, C: purpose, evidence, future, closing.
scenes.say_uz: Tartib: B, D, A, C: maqsad, dalil, kelajak, yakun.

scenes.title: Murojaat, yakun va rasmiy uslub
board: Dear Selection Committee, / Dear Professor Brown,
Thank you for considering my application.
Yours faithfully (no name) · Yours sincerely (name)
No contractions: I am, not I’m
scenes.say_native: Ism noma’lum bo‘lsa, “Dear Selection Committee” deb yozing; “Dear Sir” eskirgan. Yakunda “Thank you for considering my application” yetarli. Britaniyada ism bilan murojaat qilsangiz “Yours sincerely”, ismsiz bo‘lsa “Yours faithfully”. Uslub rasmiy: “I’m” emas, “I am”. “Please give me this chance” kabi yolvorish yozilmaydi.
scenes.say: Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss it at interview. Yours faithfully.
scenes.say_uz: Arizamni ko‘rib chiqqaningiz uchun rahmat. Uni intervyuda muhokama qilish imkoniyatidan mamnun bo‘lardim. Hurmat bilan.

scenes.title: Yutuq formulasi
board: Action verb + task + result (number)
Duty: I was responsible for social media.
Achievement: I relaunched it and doubled followers in 6 months.
Show, don’t tell.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi mavzu: yutuqlar. Formula oddiy: kuchli fe’l, nima qilganingiz va natija, iloji bo‘lsa raqam bilan. “I was responsible for social media” bu vazifa, yutuq emas. “I relaunched our faculty’s social media and doubled its followers in six months” mana bu yutuq. Ya’ni sifatlarni sanamang, harakatni ko‘rsating.
scenes.say: A duty: I was responsible for social media. An achievement: I relaunched our faculty's social media and doubled its followers in six months.
scenes.say_uz: Vazifa: ijtimoiy tarmoqlar uchun mas’ul edim. Yutuq: fakultetimiz ijtimoiy tarmoqlarini qayta ishga tushirdim va olti oyda obunachilarni ikki baravar oshirdim.

scenes.title: Kuchli fe’llar
board: led · launched · founded · designed · organised
increased · reduced · secured · won · published
by + amount: reduced costs by 30 per cent
UK: organised · US: organized

examples.t: I secured funding for a summer school for 60 students.
examples.uz: 60 nafar talaba uchun yozgi maktabga mablag‘ undirdim.

scenes.say_native: “Did”, “made”, “was involved in” kabi rangsiz fe’llar o‘rniga aniq fe’l tanlang. “Led” boshqardim, “launched” ishga tushirdim, “founded” asos soldim, “secured funding” mablag‘ undirdim. O‘zgarish miqdorini “by” bilan bering: “by 30 per cent”, ya’ni o‘ttiz foizga.
scenes.say: I led. I launched. I founded. I secured funding. We reduced processing time by thirty per cent.
scenes.say_uz: Boshqardim. Ishga tushirdim. Asos soldim. Mablag‘ undirdim. Ishlov berish vaqtini o‘ttiz foizga qisqartirdik.

scenes.title: Sifatlar ro‘yxati va noaniq miqdor
board: ✗ I am hard-working, responsible, creative and ambitious.
✗ I took part in a lot of olympiads.
✓ I won second prize in the national economics olympiad (2022).
✓ Let the evidence describe you.
scenes.say_native: Bizdagi tavsifnomalarda “mehnatsevar, mas’uliyatli, ijodkor” degan qatorni ko‘p ko‘ramiz. Inglizcha xatda bu deyarli ta’sir qilmaydi, chunki buni har kim yozishi mumkin. Ikkinchi xato: “a lot of olympiads” kabi noaniq miqdor. Qaysi olimpiada, qaysi yil, qaysi o‘rin? Aniq yozing.
scenes.say: Anyone can claim to be hard-working and creative. Give one precise fact instead: I won second prize in the national economics olympiad in 2022.
scenes.say_uz: Har kim mehnatsevar va ijodkor ekanini da’vo qilishi mumkin. Buning o‘rniga bitta aniq fakt bering: 2022-yilda milliy iqtisodiyot olimpiadasida ikkinchi o‘rinni oldim.

scenes.title: Gaplarni kuchaytiring
board: 1 I was in the student council.
2 I helped with an event.
3 I know Python well.
verb + task + result
scenes.say_native: Uchta zaif gap. Har birini yutuq formulasiga solib, kuchli gapga aylantiring: kuchli fe’l, aniq ish va natija. Raqamlarni mashq uchun o‘zingiz o‘ylab topishingiz mumkin. Ovoz chiqarib ayting yoki daftaringizga yozing, keyin namunalar bilan solishtiramiz. Har bir gapda bitta aniq natija bo‘lsa yetarli.
scenes.say: Make these three sentences stronger with an action verb, a clear task and a result.
scenes.say_uz: Bu uchta gapni harakat fe’li, aniq vazifa va natija bilan kuchaytiring.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1 As council treasurer, I managed the annual budget.
2 I co-organised a career fair for 300 students.
3 I built a Python tool that cut reporting from two days to two hours.
scenes.say_native: Namunalarni solishtiring. Birinchi gapda lavozim va mas’uliyat bor. Ikkinchisida “helped” o‘rniga “co-organised” va aniq raqam. Uchinchisida bilimning o‘zi emas, shu bilim bilan qilingan ish va vaqtdagi natija ko‘rsatilgan. Sizning variantingizda ham fe’l, aniq harakat va natija bo‘lsa, demak to‘g‘ri yo‘ldasiz.
scenes.say: As treasurer of the student council, I managed the annual budget. I co-organised a career fair for three hundred students. I built a Python tool that cut weekly reporting from two days to two hours.
scenes.say_uz: Talabalar kengashi xazinachisi sifatida yillik byudjetni boshqardim. Uch yuz talaba uchun karyera yarmarkasini hamkorlikda tashkil qildim. Haftalik hisobotni ikki kundan ikki soatga qisqartirgan Python vositasini yaratdim.

scenes.title: Maqsadlar: qisqa va uzoq muddatli
board: Short-term: Upon completion, I intend to…
Long-term: In the long term, I aim to…
Specific: where · which organisation · what change
scenes.say_native: Endi maqsadlar, ikki darajada. Qisqa muddatli: o‘qishdan keyingi bir-ikki yil. Uzoq muddatli: besh-o‘n yil ichida qanday o‘zgarishga hissa qo‘shasiz. Maqsad aniq bo‘lsin: qayerda, qaysi tashkilotda, qanday natija. “I want to be useful to my country” juda umumiy, uni joy, tashkilot va natija bilan to‘ldiring.
scenes.say: Upon completion of the programme, I intend to set up a small data unit at the Ministry of Health. In the long term, I aim to help build a national early-warning system for disease outbreaks.
scenes.say_uz: Dasturni tugatgach, Sog‘liqni saqlash vazirligida kichik ma’lumotlar bo‘limini tashkil qilmoqchiman. Uzoq muddatda kasallik tarqalishi bo‘yicha milliy erta ogohlantirish tizimini yaratishga yordam berishni maqsad qilganman.

scenes.title: Niyat fe’llari grammatikasi
board: intend to / aim to / plan to / hope to + verb
dream of + -ing: dream of opening
contribute to + noun / -ing (to = preposition)

examples.t: I hope to contribute to developing renewable energy.
examples.uz: Qayta tiklanadigan energetikani rivojlantirishga hissa qo‘shishni umid qilaman.

scenes.say_native: Grammatikaga e’tibor bering. “Intend to”, “aim to”, “plan to”, “hope to” dan keyin fe’lning oddiy shakli keladi: “aim to improve”. “Dream” esa “of” va -ing bilan ishlaydi: “dream of becoming”. “Contribute to” dagi “to” predlog, shuning uchun undan keyin ot yoki -ing keladi: “contribute to improving”.
scenes.say: I aim to improve access to clean water. I dream of opening a research centre. I want to contribute to developing renewable energy.
scenes.say_uz: Toza suvdan foydalanishni yaxshilashni maqsad qilganman. Tadqiqot markazi ochishni orzu qilaman. Qayta tiklanadigan energetikani rivojlantirishga hissa qo‘shmoqchiman.

scenes.title: Maqsad gaplaridagi xatolar
board: ✗ I dream to become… → ✓ I dream of becoming…
✗ contribute in / for → ✓ contribute to
✗ I will become the best specialist → ✓ I aim to…
✗ to develop my country → ✓ to develop the X sector in my region
scenes.say_native: To‘rt tipik xato. “Dream to become” emas, “dream of becoming”. “Contribute in” yoki “contribute for” emas, faqat “contribute to”. “I will become the best specialist” kabi va’da mag‘rur eshitiladi, “I aim to” esa ishonchli va o‘rinli. “To develop my country” esa juda keng: qaysi soha, qaysi hudud, qanday o‘zgarish, aniq ayting.
scenes.say: Say I dream of becoming, not I dream to become. Say contribute to, never contribute in. And name a sector and a region, not just your country.
scenes.say_uz: I dream to become emas, I dream of becoming deng. Contribute in emas, contribute to deng. Faqat mamlakatingizni emas, soha va hududni ayting.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri shaklni tanlang
board: 1 I intend … (return) to Samarkand.
2 I hope to contribute … the tourism sector.
3 She dreams … (open) a clinic.
4 We aim … (reduce) waste … 20 per cent.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni to‘ldiring. Qavs ichidagi fe’lni to‘g‘ri shaklga qo‘ying yoki kerakli predlogni qo‘shing. Esingizda bo‘lsin: ba’zi fe’llardan keyin “to” va oddiy fe’l, ba’zilaridan keyin predlog va -ing keladi. To‘rtinchi gapda ikkita bo‘sh joy bor: ikkinchisi o‘zgarish miqdorini bildiradi.
scenes.say: Complete the sentences with the correct verb form or preposition.
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni fe’lning to‘g‘ri shakli yoki predlog bilan to‘ldiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar: niyat fe’llari
board: 1 I intend to return to Samarkand.
2 … contribute to the tourism sector.
3 She dreams of opening a clinic.
4 We aim to reduce waste by 20 per cent.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “I intend to return to Samarkand.” Ikkinchi: “contribute to the tourism sector”, faqat “to”. Uchinchi: “She dreams of opening a clinic”, “of” va -ing. To‘rtinchi: “We aim to reduce waste by 20 per cent.” Bu yerda “by” o‘zgarish miqdorini bildiradi, ya’ni yigirma foizga.
scenes.say: I intend to return to Samarkand. I hope to contribute to the tourism sector. She dreams of opening a clinic. We aim to reduce waste by twenty per cent.
scenes.say_uz: Samarqandga qaytishni niyat qilganman. Turizm sohasiga hissa qo‘shishni umid qilaman. U klinika ochishni orzu qiladi. Chiqindilarni yigirma foizga kamaytirishni maqsad qilganmiz.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: maslahatchi bilan suhbat
board: Kamola (applicant) ↔ Mr Harris (advisor)
Topic: feedback on her draft
Listen for: opening · achievements · length
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash. Kamola jamoat salomatligi magistraturasiga grant olmoqchi va xatining qoralamasini universitetdagi maslahatchi janob Harrisga ko‘rsatdi. U uchta muammo haqida gapiradi: kirish, yutuqlar va hajm. Raqamlarga alohida e’tibor bering, oxirgi savolda hisoblash kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Harris: Kamola, your experience is impressive, but the opening is weak. You start with 'Since my childhood I have dreamed of studying abroad.' Kamola: Is that bad? Harris: Half the letters I read start that way. Begin with the vaccination campaign in Fergana. Kamola: And my achievements? Harris: Too many adjectives. Don't tell me you're hard-working. Tell me you trained forty nurses in six weeks. Kamola: Anything else? Harris: The limit is eight hundred words. You're at eleven hundred. Cut your school years.
scenes.say_uz: Harris: Kamola, tajribangiz ta’sirli, lekin kirish zaif. Siz “Bolaligimdan chet elda o‘qishni orzu qilganman” deb boshlaysiz. Kamola: Bu yomonmi? Harris: Men o‘qiydigan xatlarning yarmi shunday boshlanadi. Farg‘onadagi emlash kampaniyasidan boshlang. Kamola: Yutuqlarimchi? Harris: Sifatlar juda ko‘p. Mehnatsevar ekaningizni aytmang. Olti haftada qirqta hamshirani o‘qitganingizni ayting. Kamola: Yana nimadir bormi? Harris: Limit sakkiz yuz so‘z. Sizda o‘n bir yuz. Maktab yillaringizni olib tashlang.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 1
board: 1 What is wrong with the opening?
2 What should she start with?
3 What achievement does he mention?
4 How many words must she cut, and what?
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Kirishning nimasi yomon? Kamola xatni nima bilan boshlashi kerak? Maslahatchi yutuqqa qanday misol keltirdi? Va nechta so‘zni qisqartirish kerak, qaysi qismni? To‘rtinchi savolda limit va hozirgi hajmni solishtiring. Javoblarni ingliz tilida qisqa ayting, to‘liq gap shart emas.
scenes.say: What is wrong with the opening? What should she start with? What achievement does he mention? How many words must she cut?
scenes.say_uz: Kirishning nimasi yomon? U nima bilan boshlashi kerak? U qaysi yutuqni tilga oladi? U nechta so‘zni qisqartirishi kerak?

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 1
board: 1 A cliché: Since my childhood…
2 The vaccination campaign in Fergana
3 She trained 40 nurses in six weeks.
4 About 300 words: her school years
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: kirish siyqa ibora bilan boshlangan. Ikkinchi: Farg‘onadagi emlash kampaniyasi, ya’ni aniq voqea bilan boshlash kerak. Uchinchi: “trained forty nurses in six weeks”, sof yutuq formulasi. To‘rtinchi: limit sakkiz yuz, hajm o‘n bir yuz, demak uch yuz so‘z ortiqcha; maktab yillari haqidagi qism ketadi.
scenes.say: A cliché. The vaccination campaign. Forty nurses in six weeks. About three hundred words: her school years.
scenes.say_uz: Siyqa ibora. Emlash kampaniyasi. Olti haftada qirqta hamshira. Taxminan uch yuz so‘z: maktab yillari.

scenes.title: O‘tmish → hozir → kelajak
board: PAST: what sparked your interest
PRESENT: what you do now + the gap
FUTURE: the programme fills the gap → impact
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi mavzu, xatning eng kuchli qismi: o‘tmish, hozir va kelajakni bitta chiziqqa bog‘lash. O‘tmish: sizni shu sohaga nima olib keldi. Hozir: nima qilyapsiz va nimangiz yetishmayapti, ya’ni “gap”, bo‘shliq. Kelajak: dastur shu bo‘shliqni to‘ldiradi va siz ta’sir qilasiz. Shunda tanlovingiz tasodifiy emasligi ko‘rinadi.
scenes.say: The strongest letters tell one story. The past explains your interest. The present shows what you are missing. The future shows how the programme fills that gap.
scenes.say_uz: Eng kuchli xatlar bitta hikoya aytadi. O‘tmish qiziqishingizni tushuntiradi. Hozir nima yetishmayotganini ko‘rsatadi. Kelajak dastur shu bo‘shliqni qanday to‘ldirishini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Zamonlar: past simple va present perfect
board: Past simple + finished time: In 2022, I graduated…
Present perfect + since/for: I have worked as… since 2022
Present continuous: I am currently leading…
scenes.say_native: Bu chiziq zamonlar orqali quriladi. Aniq vaqtda tugagan voqea uchun past simple: “In 2022, I graduated”. Hozirgacha davom etayotgan tajriba uchun present perfect: “I have worked here since 2022”. O‘zbekchada “ishlayman” ham o‘tmishni, ham hozirni qamraydi, inglizchada esa zamon tanlash shart.
scenes.say: In 2022, I graduated from university. Since then, I have worked as a data analyst at a commercial bank. I am currently leading a project on mobile payments in rural areas.
scenes.say_uz: 2022-yilda universitetni tamomladim. O‘shandan beri tijorat bankida ma’lumotlar tahlilchisi bo‘lib ishlayman. Hozir qishloq joylarda mobil to‘lovlar bo‘yicha loyihaga rahbarlik qilyapman.

scenes.title: Zamon xatolari
board: ✗ I work here since 2021. → ✓ I have worked here since 2021.
✗ I have graduated in 2020. → ✓ I graduated in 2020.
✗ I am working here for three years. → ✓ I have been working here for three years.
scenes.say_native: Uchta ko‘p uchraydigan xato. “Since” yoki “for” bilan hozirgacha davom etayotgan holatda present perfect kerak: “I have worked here since 2021.” Aniq yil bor joyda esa present perfect ishlatilmaydi: “I graduated in 2020.” Rus tilidagi “работаю здесь три года” ta’sirida “I am working here for three years” deyiladi; to‘g‘risi “I have been working”.
scenes.say: I have worked here since 2021. I graduated in 2020. I have been working here for three years.
scenes.say_uz: 2021-yildan beri shu yerda ishlayman. 2020-yilda tamomlaganman. Uch yildan beri shu yerda ishlayapman.

scenes.title: Bog‘lovchi iboralar: hikoya zanjiri
board: This experience sparked my interest in…
Building on this, I…
However, I soon realised that I lacked…
This is why I am now seeking… / The programme will equip me with…
scenes.say_native: Zamonlar orasidagi ko‘prikni bog‘lovchi iboralar quradi. “This experience sparked my interest in” — qiziqish uyg‘otdi. “However, I soon realised that I lacked” — bo‘shliqni ochadi. “This is why I am now seeking” — shuning uchun hozir izlayapman. “The programme will equip me with” — dastur meni shu bilim bilan qurollantiradi.
scenes.say: This experience sparked my interest in renewable energy. Building on this, I joined a solar start-up. However, I soon realised that I lacked financial modelling skills. This is why I am now seeking a place on your MSc in Energy Economics.
scenes.say_uz: Bu tajriba menda qayta tiklanadigan energiyaga qiziqish uyg‘otdi. Shunga tayanib, quyosh energiyasi startapiga qo‘shildim. Biroq tez orada moliyaviy modellashtirish ko‘nikmalarim yetishmasligini angladim. Shuning uchun hozir sizning Energiya iqtisodiyoti magistraturangizdan joy izlayapman.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri zamonni qo‘ying
board: 1 I (work) at the clinic since 2023.
2 In 2021, I (win) a regional science prize.
3 I currently (lead) a team of four.
4 After the programme, I (plan) to return to Andijan.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Qavs ichidagi fe’lni to‘g‘ri zamonga qo‘ying. Har birida vaqt ishorasini toping: “since”, aniq yil, “currently” yoki “after the programme”. Aynan shu ishora qaysi zamon kerakligini aytadi. Ikkinchi gapdagi fe’l noto‘g‘ri fe’llardan, shakliga e’tibor bering. To‘liq gapni ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Put the verbs into the correct tense. Look for the time markers.
scenes.say_uz: Fe’llarni to‘g‘ri zamonga qo‘ying. Vaqt ishoralariga qarang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: zamonlar
board: 1 have worked / have been working
2 won (win – won – won)
3 am currently leading
4 plan (to return)
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “I have worked” yoki “I have been working at the clinic since 2023”, chunki “since” bor. Ikkinchi: “In 2021, I won”, aniq yil, demak past simple; “win” noto‘g‘ri fe’l: win, won, won. Uchinchi: “I am currently leading”, ayni payt. To‘rtinchi: “After the programme, I plan to return”.
scenes.say: I have worked at the clinic since 2023. In 2021, I won a regional science prize. I am currently leading a team of four. After the programme, I plan to return to Andijan.
scenes.say_uz: 2023-yildan beri klinikada ishlayman. 2021-yilda viloyat ilmiy mukofotini qo‘lga kiritdim. Hozir to‘rt kishilik jamoaga rahbarlik qilyapman. Dasturdan keyin Andijonga qaytishni rejalashtiryapman.

scenes.title: Namuna: butun chiziq bitta xatboshida
board: Past → Present → Gap → Programme → Future
Nukus · water authority · drip irrigation
scenes.say_native: Bu namunada butun chiziq bor. Tinglayotganda har bir bosqichni belgilab boring: qachon boshlagan, hozir nima qilyapti, qanday muammoni ko‘ryapti, nimasi yetishmayapti, dastur nima beradi va qaytgach nima qiladi. Zamonlarga ham quloq soling: past simple, present perfect, present continuous va kelajak rejasi ketma-ket keladi.
scenes.say: In 2020, I joined the regional water authority in Nukus as a junior engineer. Since then, I have maintained irrigation canals, and I am currently responsible for a forty-kilometre section. However, I have seen how much water is lost before it reaches the fields, and I lack the training to design modern solutions. Your MSc in Water Management will give me these skills, and upon my return I intend to lead a pilot project on drip irrigation.
scenes.say_uz: 2020-yilda Nukusdagi viloyat suv xo‘jaligi boshqarmasiga kichik muhandis bo‘lib ishga kirdim. O‘shandan beri sug‘orish kanallariga xizmat ko‘rsataman va hozir qirq kilometrlik qism uchun mas’ulman. Biroq dalaga yetib bormasdan qancha suv yo‘qolishini ko‘rdim, zamonaviy yechimlarni loyihalash uchun esa bilimim yetishmaydi. Sizning Suv resurslarini boshqarish magistraturangiz menga shu ko‘nikmalarni beradi va qaytgach, tomchilatib sug‘orish bo‘yicha tajriba loyihasiga rahbarlik qilmoqchiman.

scenes.title: Bo‘shliq va maqsadni toping
board: 1 Since when has he worked there?
2 What is he responsible for now?
3 What does he lack? (the gap)
4 What will he do upon his return?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. U yerda qachondan beri ishlaydi? Hozir nima uchun mas’ul? Unga nima yetishmaydi, ya’ni bo‘shliq nima? Qaytgach nima qilmoqchi? Bo‘shliqni topish eng muhimi, chunki aynan shu gap dasturni tanlash sababini mantiqiy qiladi. Javoblarni qisqa, ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Answer the four questions about the paragraph you just heard.
scenes.say_uz: Hozir eshitgan xatboshingiz haqidagi to‘rtta savolga javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar va tahlil
board: 1 Since 2020
2 A 40-km section of canals
3 The training to design modern solutions
4 Lead a pilot project on drip irrigation
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: 2020-yildan beri; qirq kilometrlik kanal qismi uchun mas’ul; zamonaviy yechimlarni loyihalash bo‘yicha bilim yetishmaydi; qaytgach tomchilatib sug‘orish bo‘yicha tajriba loyihasiga rahbarlik qilmoqchi. “However” so‘zi aynan bo‘shliqni ochib berganiga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Since 2020. A forty-kilometre section of canals. The training to design modern solutions. A pilot project on drip irrigation.
scenes.say_uz: 2020-yildan beri. Qirq kilometrlik kanal qismi. Zamonaviy yechimlarni loyihalash bo‘yicha bilim. Tomchilatib sug‘orish bo‘yicha tajriba loyihasi.

scenes.title: Ishonchli, lekin kamtar ohang
board: Arrogant: I am the best candidate you will find.
Too humble: I know I am not good enough, but…
Balanced: I believe my experience has prepared me to…
Also: With the support of my team, I… · I am eager to develop…
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi mavzu: ohang. Ikki chekka bor: takabburlik, ya’ni “I am the best candidate”, va haddan tashqari kamtarlik: “I know I am not good enough”. Bizda kamtarlik fazilat, lekin inglizcha xatda o‘zini kamsitish ishonchsizlik deb o‘qiladi. Muvozanat: faktni ishonch bilan aytasiz, jamoani tan olasiz va o‘rganishga tayyorligingizni bildirasiz.
scenes.say: Arrogant: I am the best candidate you will ever find. Too humble: I know I am not good enough. Balanced: I believe my three years in rural clinics have prepared me well for this programme.
scenes.say_uz: Takabbur: men siz topadigan eng yaxshi nomzodman. Haddan tashqari kamtar: yetarlicha yaxshi emasligimni bilaman. Muvozanatli: qishloq klinikalaridagi uch yillik tajribam meni bu dasturga yaxshi tayyorlagan deb hisoblayman.

scenes.title: Xushomad va mubolag‘a
board: ✗ your world-famous, most prestigious university
✗ I am a perfect fit / I will change the world
✓ Your module in Urban Data Analytics…
✓ I hope to contribute to…
scenes.say_native: Yana ikki xato. Birinchisi xushomad: “your world-famous, most prestigious university”. Universitet o‘z nufuzini biladi. O‘rniga aniq modul, professor yoki laboratoriyani tilga oling, bu tadqiqot qilganingizni ko‘rsatadi. Ikkinchisi mubolag‘a: “I will change the world”. Ulkan va’da o‘rniga o‘lchab bo‘ladigan, real maqsad yozing.
scenes.say: Don't flatter the university. Mention a specific module or lab instead. And don't promise to change the world. A realistic goal is far more convincing.
scenes.say_uz: Universitetga xushomad qilmang. Uning o‘rniga aniq modul yoki laboratoriyani tilga oling. Dunyoni o‘zgartirishni va’da qilmang. Real maqsad ancha ishonarli.

scenes.title: Ohangni baholang
board: 1 I am undoubtedly the strongest applicant.
2 I am just an ordinary student, so maybe I don't deserve this.
3 I believe this experience has prepared me well.
4 Your university is the best in the world.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Har biri haqida qaror qiling: takabbur, haddan tashqari kamtar, muvozanatli yoki xushomad. Keyin muvozanatli bo‘lmagan gaplardan kamida bittasini qayta yozing: faktni saqlang, ohangni o‘zgartiring. Maqsad o‘zingizni kamsitish ham, maqtash ham emas, dalil bilan gapirish.
scenes.say: Is each sentence arrogant, too humble, balanced or flattering? Then rewrite one of them.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gap takabburmi, haddan tashqari kamtarmi, muvozanatlimi yoki xushomadmi? Keyin bittasini qayta yozing.

scenes.title: Javoblar: ohang
board: 1 arrogant · 2 too humble
3 balanced · 4 flattering
Fix 1: I believe my results show I am ready for…
Fix 4: Your MSc stands out for its focus on…
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi takabbur, ikkinchi haddan tashqari kamtar, uchinchi muvozanatli, to‘rtinchi xushomad. Birinchisini shunday tuzatish mumkin: “I believe my results show that I am ready for this programme.” To‘rtinchisi o‘rniga: “Your MSc stands out for its focus on rural development.”
scenes.say: I believe my results show that I am ready for this programme. Your MSc stands out for its focus on rural development.
scenes.say_uz: Natijalarim bu dasturga tayyor ekanimni ko‘rsatadi deb hisoblayman. Sizning magistraturangiz qishloq taraqqiyotiga e’tibori bilan ajralib turadi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: grant intervyusi
board: Panel ↔ Bekzod (engineer, Nukus)
Listen for: experience · why this MSc
achievement · 5-year goal · modest phrase
scenes.say_native: Ko‘p grantlarda xatdan keyin intervyu bo‘ladi va komissiya xatdagi gaplaringizni og‘zaki tekshiradi. Bekzod Nukusdan, suv xo‘jaligi muhandisi. Uning tajribasi, dasturni tanlash sababi, yutug‘i va besh yillik maqsadini ushlang. Yutug‘ini qanday kamtar, lekin aniq aytganiga ayniqsa e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Panel: Why this programme, Bekzod? Bekzod: I've worked at the water authority in Nukus for four years, and we lose too much water before it reaches the fields. Your module on smart irrigation addresses exactly that. Panel: Your biggest achievement? Bekzod: A new canal monitoring schedule. With a team of four, we cut losses in our section by about fifteen per cent in one season. I had a very supportive manager, but the idea was mine. Panel: And in five years? Bekzod: Leading drip irrigation pilots in two districts.
scenes.say_uz: Komissiya: Nega aynan shu dastur, Bekzod? Bekzod: Nukusdagi suv xo‘jaligi boshqarmasida to‘rt yildan beri ishlayman va dalaga yetib bormasdan juda ko‘p suv yo‘qotamiz. Sizning aqlli sug‘orish modulingiz aynan shu muammoga qaratilgan. Komissiya: Eng katta yutug‘ingiz? Bekzod: Kanallarni kuzatishning yangi jadvali. To‘rt kishilik jamoa bilan bir mavsumda o‘z qismimizdagi yo‘qotishlarni taxminan o‘n besh foizga kamaytirdik. Rahbarim juda qo‘llab-quvvatladi, lekin g‘oya meniki edi. Komissiya: Besh yildan keyin-chi? Bekzod: Ikki tumanda tomchilatib sug‘orish tajriba loyihalariga rahbarlik qilish.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 2
board: 1 How long has Bekzod worked in Nukus?
2 Why did he choose this programme?
3 What did his team achieve?
4 Which sentence sounds modest but confident?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Bekzod Nukusda qancha vaqtdan beri ishlaydi? Nega aynan shu dasturni tanladi, qaysi modulni tilga oldi? Jamoasi nimaga erishdi, raqamni ayting. Va qaysi gap kamtar, lekin ishonchli eshitildi? Oxirgi savol eng qiziqarlisi: u rahbarini tan oldi, lekin o‘z hissasini ham yashirmadi.
scenes.say: Answer the four questions about Bekzod's interview.
scenes.say_uz: Bekzodning intervyusi haqidagi to‘rtta savolga javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 2
board: 1 For four years
2 The module on smart irrigation fits his problem.
3 They cut water losses by about 15% in one season.
4 I had a very supportive manager, but the idea was mine.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. To‘rt yildan beri: “I’ve worked for four years”, present perfect. Dasturni aniq modul uchun tanlagan, xushomad emas, moslik ko‘rsatgan. Jamoasi bir mavsumda yo‘qotishlarni taxminan o‘n besh foizga kamaytirgan. Kamtar, lekin ishonchli gap: “I had a very supportive manager, but the idea was mine.”
scenes.say: For four years. The smart irrigation module. About fifteen per cent in one season. I had a very supportive manager, but the idea was mine.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt yildan beri. Aqlli sug‘orish moduli. Bir mavsumda taxminan o‘n besh foiz. Rahbarim juda qo‘llab-quvvatladi, lekin g‘oya meniki edi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: kalit so‘zlar urg‘usi
board: aCHIEVEment /əˈtʃiːvmənt/ · deVELopment
opporTUnity /ˌɒpəˈtjuːnəti/ · SCHOlarship /ˈskɒləʃɪp/
deTERmined /dɪˈtɜːmɪnd/ (not -maind)
conTRIbute /kənˈtrɪbjuːt/
scenes.say_native: Intervyuda bu so‘zlarni ko‘p aytasiz, urg‘uni to‘g‘ri qo‘ying. O‘zbek tilida urg‘u ko‘pincha oxirgi bo‘g‘inga tushadi, inglizchada esa har so‘zning o‘z joyi bor: aCHIEVEment, deVELopment, opporTUnity, SCHOlarship. “Determined” ning oxiri “maynd” emas, qisqa “mind”. “Contribute” da urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: conTRIbute.
scenes.say: Achievement. Development. Opportunity. Scholarship. Determined. Contribute. I am determined to make the most of this opportunity.
scenes.say_uz: Yutuq. Rivojlanish. Imkoniyat. Stipendiya. Qat’iyatli. Hissa qo‘shmoq. Bu imkoniyatdan to‘liq foydalanishga qat’iy qaror qilganman.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa: to‘rt gaplik hikoya
board: 1 Past: In 20…, I … , which sparked my interest in…
2 Present: I have … since… / I am currently…
3 Gap: However, I lack… This is why I am applying for…
4 Future: Upon my return, I intend to…
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy vazifa. O‘z hikoyangizni to‘rt gapda ayting yoki yozing: o‘tmishdagi uchqun, hozirgi ishingiz, bo‘shliq va dastur, keyin kelajak maqsadi. Doskadagi qoliplardan foydalaning, zamonlarni to‘g‘ri tanlang va kamida bitta raqam qo‘shing. Ohang ishonchli, lekin kamtar bo‘lsin. Keyin namunani tinglaysiz.
scenes.say: Tell your own story in four sentences: past, present, the gap, and your future goal.
scenes.say_uz: O‘z hikoyangizni to‘rt gapda ayting: o‘tmish, hozir, bo‘shliq va kelajakdagi maqsad.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: Past simple → present perfect → however → intend to
a number: three departments
modest + specific
scenes.say_native: Namunani tinglang va o‘z javobingiz bilan solishtiring. Birinchi gapda aniq yil va joy bor. Ikkinchisida present perfect va present continuous birga ishlagan, raqam ham bor. Uchinchisida “however” bo‘shliqni ochadi, “which is why” dasturga ko‘prik soladi. To‘rtinchisi aniq va real maqsad.
scenes.say: In 2021, I volunteered at a children's hospital in Bukhara, which sparked my interest in health management. I have worked as a hospital administrator since 2023, and I am currently digitising patient records for three departments. However, I lack formal training in health economics, which is why I am applying for your MSc. Upon my return, I intend to help regional hospitals plan their budgets using real data.
scenes.say_uz: 2021-yilda Buxorodagi bolalar shifoxonasida ko‘ngilli bo‘ldim va bu menda sog‘liqni saqlashni boshqarishga qiziqish uyg‘otdi. 2023-yildan beri shifoxona ma’muri bo‘lib ishlayman va hozir uchta bo‘lim uchun bemorlar qaydlarini raqamlashtiryapman. Biroq sog‘liqni saqlash iqtisodiyoti bo‘yicha rasmiy ta’limim yo‘q, shuning uchun sizning magistraturangizga ariza topshiryapman. Qaytganimdan so‘ng viloyat shifoxonalariga real ma’lumotlar asosida byudjet rejalashtirishda yordam bermoqchiman.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Structure: purpose + hook → background → evidence → fit + goals → thanks
Achievements: verb + task + result (number)
Past → present → gap → future (correct tenses)
Tone: confident facts, no flattery · check limit and names
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Kirish maqsad va aniq voqea bilan boshlanadi. Yutuqlar kuchli fe’l, aniq ish va raqamli natija bilan yoziladi. O‘tmish, hozir va kelajak bitta chiziqqa bog‘lanadi, bo‘shliqni dastur to‘ldiradi. Ohang ishonchli, lekin kamtar. Yuborishdan oldin so‘z limitini va universitet nomini tekshiring, xatni ovoz chiqarib o‘qing.
scenes.say: Open with a real moment. Prove achievements with numbers. Connect past, present and future. Sound confident, not arrogant.
scenes.say_uz: Real voqea bilan boshlang. Yutuqlarni raqamlar bilan isbotlang. O‘tmish, hozir va kelajakni bog‘lang. Takabbur emas, ishonchli eshiting.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: a 200-word motivation letter
5 parts · 2 achievements with numbers
past → present → gap → future
Success: no clichés, no contractions, 190–210 words
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz tanlagan haqiqiy grant yoki stipendiya uchun 200 so‘zlik motivatsion xat yozing. Besh qism bo‘lsin, kamida ikkita yutuq raqam bilan. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: siyqa iboralar va qisqartmalar yo‘q, hajmi 190 dan 210 so‘zgacha. Keyingi darsda tez nutqni tushunishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is a two-hundred-word motivation letter. Next time, we will learn to understand fast, natural speech.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: ikki yuz so‘zlik motivatsion xat. Keyingi safar tez, tabiiy nutqni tushunishni o‘rganamiz.

homework_uz: O‘zingiz tanlagan haqiqiy grant yoki stipendiya (masalan, Chevening, DAAD, Erasmus Mundus yoki El-Yurt Umidi) uchun 200 so‘zlik motivatsion xat yozing. Xatda besh qism bo‘lsin: maqsad va aniq voqea bilan kirish, ta’lim va tajriba, kamida ikkita raqamli yutuq, nega aynan shu dastur va kelajak maqsadlari, qisqa yakun. O‘tmish, hozir, bo‘shliq va kelajak chizig‘i aniq ko‘rinsin, zamonlar to‘g‘ri ishlatilsin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: “since my childhood” kabi siyqa iboralar, xushomad va qisqartmalar yo‘q, hajmi 190–210 so‘z. Keyingi darsda tez nutqni tushunishni o‘rganamiz.

quiz.q: Which is the strongest opening sentence for a scholarship letter?
options: My name is Aziz and I was born in 2001 in Namangan.
Since my childhood I have dreamed of studying abroad.
I am applying for the Chevening Scholarship to study for an MSc in Public Health.
It is a great honour for me to write this letter.
quiz.why_uz: Kuchli kirish maqsadni darhol aytadi: qaysi grant va qaysi dastur. Qolganlari tarjimai hol, siyqa ibora yoki bo‘sh rasmiyatchilik.

quiz.q: Choose the correct form: 'I ___ as a data analyst since 2022.'
quiz.why_uz: Since bilan hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat uchun present perfect kerak: I have worked.

quiz.q: Choose the correct form: 'In 2020, I ___ from university.'
quiz.why_uz: Aniq tugagan vaqt (in 2020) bilan past simple ishlatiladi; present perfect aniq yil bilan kelmaydi.

quiz.q: Complete: 'She dreams ___ a clinic in her village.'
quiz.why_uz: Dream dan keyin of va -ing keladi: dream of opening. “Dream to open” o‘zbekchadan kalka.

quiz.q: Complete: 'I hope to contribute ___ the energy sector.'
quiz.why_uz: Contribute faqat to predlogi bilan ishlatiladi: contribute to.

quiz.q: Which sentence describes an achievement, not a duty?
options: I was responsible for the faculty website.
I relaunched the faculty website and doubled its traffic in six months.
I am a creative and hard-working person.
quiz.why_uz: Yutuq formulasi: kuchli fe’l, aniq ish va raqamli natija. Qolganlari vazifa, sifat yoki noaniq da’vo.

quiz.q: Which sentence has the most balanced tone?
options: I am undoubtedly the best candidate you will find.
I am just an ordinary student and may not deserve this.
I believe my experience has prepared me well for this programme.
Your university is the most prestigious in the world.
quiz.why_uz: Muvozanatli ohang: ishonch bor (I believe), lekin maqtanish, o‘zini kamsitish yoki xushomad yo‘q.

quiz.q: In British convention, which ending follows 'Dear Selection Committee'?
quiz.why_uz: Ism noma’lum bo‘lsa, Britaniya an’anasida Yours faithfully; ism bilan murojaat qilinsa, Yours sincerely.

quiz.q: What is the function of 'However, I soon realised that I lacked financial modelling skills'?
options: It introduces the gap that the programme will fill.
quiz.why_uz: However dan keyingi gap bo‘shliqni ochadi va dastur nega kerakligini mantiqiy qiladi.

quiz.q: Which word is stressed on the second syllable?
quiz.why_uz: aCHIEVEment: urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda. SCHOlarship va PROgramme birinchi, opporTUnity uchinchi bo‘g‘inda.
